definitions.explanation: The break from school or work during summer.

examples.japanese: {夏休|なつやす}みの{宿題|しゅくだい}
{夏休|なつやす}みはいつからですか。
{夏休|なつやす}みに{家族|かぞく}で{海|うみ}に{行|い}きます。
examples.english: We're going to the beach with the family during summer vacation.

notes:
{夏休|なつやす}み is the summer vacation period. In Japan, school summer break typically runs from late July to late August (about 40 days).

SEASONAL VACATIONS:
- {春休|はるやす}み: spring break (late March–early April)
- {夏休|なつやす}み: summer vacation (late July–late August)
- {冬休|ふゆやす}み: winter break (late December–early January)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夏休|なつやす}みの{宿題|しゅくだい}: summer homework
- {夏休|なつやす}みの{自由研究|じゆうけんきゅう}: independent study project (a school tradition)
- {夏休|なつやす}みに{入|はい}る: summer vacation begins

CULTURE:
{夏休|なつやす}みの{宿題|しゅくだい} is a hallmark of Japanese school life. Students often rush to finish it in the last days of vacation — a relatable cultural topic.
